identity_cost.detail: the MEGA account is created with an email address and a password, confirmed by a link MEGA emails, and the vendor's guide lists no phone field, so whether the form asks a phone number is unverified. MEGA S4 is sold on the Pro Flexi plan, and the upgrade takes Visa or Mastercard, Google Pay, Bitcoin or a UnionPay bank card

reliability_note: MEGA has run since 2013; S4 is a newer product line (2025) so the durability record on S4 itself is short. Brand-level: no mass data-loss event. Note the 2013 MEGA breach was credential/architecture, not storage loss.
